truth_standard: Defined means the requirement and stable trait identity exist.
Executable means runnable implementation code exists.
Tested means functional tests passed against the implementation.
Seeded means a verified seed instance or built artifact contains the capability.
Booted means a verified seed generation booted with the capability already present.
Used means a physical user-facing operation was proven on an authorized machine.

overall.plain: All seven everyday human capabilities are Defined, Executable, Tested, and Seeded on BBPI4. Booting a generation that already contains them is the next shared evidence gate.
overall.human_action: None right now. PC seed construction and the next boot verification are automated build work.

human_capabilities.name: Web browsing
human_capabilities.current: Browser-launch runtime and the WEB seed bundle are verified on BBPI4. Firefox ESR is wired into the PC seed definition, whose fresh artifact and boot proof are pending.
human_capabilities.next: Boot a generation that already contains WEB, then prove a webpage opens.

human_capabilities.name: Garden / Files
human_capabilities.current: Garden and its Documents, Photos, Music, Videos, Downloads, Projects, and Shared plots are in the verified BBPI4 seed payload.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with Garden already present, then open and save a real human file.

human_capabilities.name: Music, photos, and video
human_capabilities.current: Unified media launch behavior and its seed bundle are verified on BBPI4. MPV and audio foundations remain wired into the PC seed definition.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with MEDIA present, then prove image, audio, and video playback.

human_capabilities.name: Writing and word processing
human_capabilities.current: Document creation/editor behavior and the WRITE seed bundle are verified on BBPI4. LibreOffice Writer remains wired into the PC seed definition.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with WRITE present, then create, edit, save, and reopen a document.

human_capabilities.name: Intent and assistance
human_capabilities.current: Everyday-language routing and the INTENT seed bundle are verified on BBPI4.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with INTENT present and prove a typed or spoken request opens the intended capability.

human_capabilities.name: Connectivity
human_capabilities.current: Connectivity probing and the CONNECT seed bundle are verified on BBPI4 over the pretrusted USB-C SSH route.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with CONNECT present and exercise network, USB, and Bluetooth through the human surface.

human_capabilities.name: Recovery
human_capabilities.current: Read-only recovery inspection and the RECOVER seed bundle are verified on BBPI4; deployment preserved rollback and added no persistence.
human_capabilities.next: Boot with RECOVER present and prove a safe user-visible diagnosis and rollback path.

system_milestones.detail: Runtime, functional tests, seven parallel bundle builds, and complete seed payload assembly exist on main.

system_milestones.name: Pi human-trait seed
system_milestones.detail: Run 32525836598 completed from source commit e7d7a8db after validating and deploying all seven bundles over pretrusted USB-C SSH with the gold seed preserved.

system_milestones.name: PC seed integration definition
system_milestones.detail: The active PC seed branch includes Firefox ESR, PCManFM, MPV, LibreOffice Writer, Xorg/Openbox, Garden, and all seven trait bundles.

system_milestones.name: Booted gate
system_milestones.detail: The BBPI4 payload was added to an already-running seed. A generation must boot with the traits already present before Booted is earned.

system_milestones.name: Physical use gate
system_milestones.detail: WEB, Garden, MEDIA, WRITE, INTENT, CONNECT, and RECOVER still need physical user-facing receipts.
